# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.2.0)
set(toolchainVersion 14_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.2.0)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

# Importa o Pico SDK
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

# Define a placa como Pico W
set(PICO_BOARD pico_w)

project(HydroSense_v3 C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# Inicializa o Pico SDK
pico_sdk_init()

# Configura o FreeRTOS para RP2040
set(FREERTOS_CONFIG_FILE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} CACHE STRING "")
set(FREERTOS_PORT GCC_RP2040 CACHE STRING "")

# Adiciona o FreeRTOS
add_subdirectory(FreeRTOS-Kernel)

# ============================================================
# HydroSense v3.0 - Arquivos fonte
# ============================================================
set(SOURCES
    # Main
    src/main_v3.c
    
    # Sensores
    src/sensors/vl53l0x.c
    src/sensors/aht10.c
    src/sensors/tcs3200.c
    
    # Sistemas
    src/tpa_system.c
    src/feeding_system.c
    src/webserver_v2.c
    src/dhcpserver.c
    src/log_system.c
)

# Adiciona o executável
add_executable(HydroSense_v3 ${SOURCES})

# Definições de compilação
target_compile_definitions(HydroSense_v3 PRIVATE
    PICO_STACK_SIZE=0x1000
    PICO_CORE1_STACK_SIZE=0x800
    PICO_HEAP_SIZE=0x8000
    CYW43_HOST_NAME="HydroSense"
    PICO_CYW43_ARCH_THREADSAFE_BACKGROUND=1
)

# Inclui diretórios de header
target_include_directories(HydroSense_v3 PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/sensors
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/arch
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS-Kernel/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/ThirdParty/GCC/RP2040/include
)

# Bibliotecas necessárias
target_link_libraries(HydroSense_v3
    # Pico SDK
    pico_stdlib
    pico_cyw43_arch_lwip_threadsafe_background
    pico_lwip_http
    pico_multicore
    
    # Hardware
    hardware_pwm
    hardware_adc
    hardware_i2c
    hardware_gpio
    hardware_uart
    hardware_rtc
    hardware_timer
    hardware_watchdog
    
    # FreeRTOS
    freertos_kernel
)

# Habilita USB e UART para debug
pico_enable_stdio_usb(HydroSense_v3 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(HydroSense_v3 0)

# Cria arquivo UF2 e outros formatos
pico_add_extra_outputs(HydroSense_v3)

# Informação de build
message(STATUS "")
message(STATUS "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
message(STATUS "║  HydroSense v3.0 - Sistema de Aquicultura + Hidroponia       ║")
message(STATUS "╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣")
message(STATUS "║  📊 Sensores: VL53L0X, AHT10, TCS3200                         ║")
message(STATUS "║  🐟 Alimentação: 08:00 e 16:00 (50g)                          ║")
message(STATUS "║  🚰 TPA: Sujeira (25%) + Rotatividade (50%/2h)                ║")
message(STATUS "║  🌐 Dashboard: HTTP em 192.168.4.1                            ║")
message(STATUS "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
message(STATUS "")
